newsitem.title: MALTA: Malta Mid-Med bank appoints three chairmen.
newsitem.headline: Malta Mid-Med bank appoints three chairmen.

text.p: Malta's Mid-Med Bank has appointed a chairman for each of its three major subsidiaries.

Dennis De Giorgio has been appointed chairman of Lohombus Bank Ltd which specialises in home loans, Norman Spiteri for Mid-Med Bank (Overseas) Ltd and Philip Sciberras for Mid-Med Life Assurance Co Ltd.
Mid-Med Chairman Alfred Mifsud said the new board of Mid-Med Bank had decided to give more autonomy to its major subsidiaries.

De Giorgio joined Barclays Bank in 1947 and was general manager of Bank of Valletta from 1974 to 1987. He has also served on the Central Bank Investment Committee as director of the Investment Finance Bank.
Spiteri qualified as a chartered accountant in 1964 and was Coopers & Lybrand's representative in Malta from 1970 to 1988.
Sciberras has acted as legal adviser to a number of corporations including Air Malta, Malta Shipbuilding, MedServ and Sea Malta.
